subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this issue stay open as the Control UI/Gateway structured reply metadata coordination item while final fallback/no-output semantics are owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561, or should maintainers split/close it after choosing canonical items?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI UX, Gateway protocol shape, runtime prompt context, and durable delivery semantics; an automated fix could choose the wrong permanent boundary while PR 90745 and issue 87561 already own major slices.

options.title: Keep Open And Split Scope
options.body: Keep this issue open for the Control UI/Gateway structured reply metadata contract and explicitly route final fallback delivery semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

options.title: Use PR 90745 As Canonical Reply Path
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 as the candidate reply-metadata fix after conflicts and sibling-surface review, with any Control UI-specific gap tracked as follow-up.

options.title: Close After Canonical Split
options.body: Close this issue only after maintainers pick one canonical reply metadata item and one canonical no-output delivery item that preserve this Control UI context.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Split Scope
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the Control UI/Gateway structured reply metadata contract and explicitly route final fallback delivery semantics to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

likelyOwner.reason: The local current-main blame and recent area history cover the Control UI, protocol, and runtime-context files involved in the boundary decision.
